Ali Usman to Roston Chase, out Caught&Bowled!! Would you believe it? That's a killer blow. Two balls left to stumps and Pakistan have got the West Indies captain. This is such a soft dismissal. Chase had done all the hard work, but he could have been bit smarter in the last few minutes. The batters didn't waste time and allowed Pakistan spinners to race through their overs, that allowed them to bowl this over and it has resulted in a wicket. There was a slight pause before this delivery - did that put Chase off? Floated delivery, overpitched and Chase spoons a simple return catch. The ball did dip on him but he could have played that better. Pakistan walk back delighted. Roston Chase c and b Ali Usman 17(45) [4s-2]

Ravi Rampaul | West Indies bowling coach: [On Warrican's six-wicket haul] Yeah, definitely. He was really good for us today, picking up six wickets, staying at the stumps, and using the conditions very well for us. [On the discipline shown by the fast bowlers despite limited assistance] Yeah, it's something that we talked about this morning. Obviously, there's more assistance for the slower bowlers, and the pacers needed to be a little more consistent to allow them the time to be able to attack with the ball. And, proud of the bowling group, the way that we went out this morning. [On King's availability] No, I'm not sure. The medical staff probably have that covered. [On what would be a defendable target on this surface] It seems that anything we get, we will have to defend it. But definitely looking at the pitch and the amount of spin the Pakistan spinners are getting, we probably need to push it over 150.

10:28 Local Time, 14:28 GMT, 19:58 IST: With Brandon King ruled out of the Test, West Indies' innings has come to an end. So, Pakistan need 75 to level the series and end their 8-match losing streak away from home. Four wickets apiece for the spinners - Sajid Khan and Ali Usman. They triggered the collapse yesterday and WI couldn't recover after that. The hosts managed to add just 14 runs to their overnight score. Roach fell for a duck trying to slog one against Ali Usman. Greaves tried to play across the line and dragged one that kept a bit low to drag it onto his stumps. And, Shamar Joseph - who struck a couple of boundaries - was the last one to get dismissed as he attempted another big shot. Plenty of assistance for the spinners on this deck and a lot of deliveries are keeping low as well. However, Pakistan should fancy their chances of chasing it down. The run-chase coming up in 10 minutes..
